name: m4-symfinal-unweighted
description: The candidate cut from [retronym/scala#199](https://github.com/retronym/scala/pull/199) against `2.13.x`, on `SymbolOpsBenchmark`'s `unweighted` workload: one pass each of `findMember`, `overridingPairs`, `subst` and `erasure`, so the first two take most of the op. Does this separate the builds better than the weighted `all` in `m4-symfinal-symops`? The percentage alone won't say, so compare the change with the spread between forks.
Both builds with the release optimizer settings (`SCALA_RELEASE_OPT`); patched JDK 26, 8G heap, no profiler.
